dependencyDirection: MMORPG -> MMOFramework -> Engine/GAS/GameFeatures/ModularGameplay/EnhancedInput. MMOFramework never depends on MMORPG, backend, LyraGame or ShooterCore.

fields.ActionSets: optional MMOExperienceActionSet soft assets; empty is valid when GameFeatureData supplies its own actions

fields.PawnClass: /Script/MMORPG.MMOCharacter or the actual teaching hero Blueprint generated class
fields.InputMappingContext: optional real UInputMappingContext asset; consumers add/remove it by local-player lifecycle
fields.AnimInstanceClass: optional real compatible UAnimInstance generated class; consumer applies it to the mesh
fields.InputConfig: /Game/MMO/Input/DA_MMOInputConfig; client asynchronous dependency closure includes each soft InputAction

fields.Actions: Add Components/Add Widgets actions from actual available framework classes; no invented field values

manager.host: AMMOGameState : AModularGameStateBase; CreateDefaultSubobject<UMMOExperienceManagerComponent> on every server/client GameState
manager.select: SetCurrentExperience(FPrimaryAssetId(TEXT("MMOExperience"),TEXT("DA_MMOExperience"))) -> bool; server only; one selection per world; repeat same ID is idempotent
manager.ready: CallOrRegister_OnReady(FOnMMOExperienceReady::FDelegate) immediately calls when ready, otherwise registers; weak/UObject-bound delegate recommended
manager.read: IsExperienceReady(), GetCurrentExperience(), GetPawnData(), GetSelectedExperienceId(), LoadState, FailureReason
manager.failure: OnExperienceFailed(Blueprint event), LogMMOExperience, 60-second load deadline; no Ready on error
manager.ordering: Resolve selected asset -> asynchronous soft dependency closure -> reference-counted GameFeature activation -> per-world instanced Actions -> Ready -> notify existing PawnExtensions. No fixed Delay.
manager.teardown: Cancel pending streamable requests; deactivate owned actions in reverse order; retain strong actions/loaded handles until asynchronous pausers finish; unregister actions; release process-scoped plugin counts. Do not separately own the same feature from the old GameInstance loader.
manager.gameFeatureInitialState: MMOCore .uplugin BuiltInInitialFeatureState=Registered; Experience owns runtime activation/release, old GameInstance loader removed.

playerState.ownership: Replicate selected PawnData on PS or assign replicated PawnExtension.PawnData on every spawned server Pawn. Keep one FMMOGrantedAbilityHandles per configured AbilitySet on the authority PS.
playerState.initialization: Create UMMOAbilitySystemComponent as the PlayerState ASC default subobject, then ASC->InitAbilityActorInfo(this, GetPawn()) before grants; nullptr avatar is allowed while waiting for backend/Experience. Existing UMMOAttributes default subobject remains authoritative; leave GrantedAttributes empty to avoid a second instance of the same class.
playerState.grant: LoadedSet->GrantToAbilitySystem(ASC,this,Handles) -> bool. All soft classes must already be loaded by Experience. Rejects non-authority or reusing a nonempty handle ownership slot. InputID is copied to FGameplayAbilitySpec.InputID; InputTag to GetDynamicSpecSourceTags().
playerState.cleanup: Handles.TakeFromAbilitySystem(ASC) when replacing selected pawn data or releasing owning player/equipment. Do not remove PS-owned default grants merely because its pawn dies. Instant effects are not reversible by an active-effect handle.

gameMode.requiredGate: A player may spawn only when BOTH ExperienceManager.IsExperienceReady() and its backend-authenticated PlayerState.bSessionReady are true.
gameMode.onExperienceReady: Configure each valid player's PawnData/default grants and call the shared TryStartPlayer gate. Backend-load completion calls that same gate; either callback may arrive first.
gameMode.pawnClass: GetDefaultPawnClassForController_Implementation returns ExperienceManager.GetPawnData()->PawnClass.Get() after Ready, not LoadSynchronous during login.
gameMode.spawn: On server, set PawnExtension.SetPawnData(the loaded selected data) before or immediately after possession; CheckDefaultInitialization handles order. Do not restore the previous unconditional hard-coded GiveAbility path.

api: SetPawnData(UMMOPawnData*) -> bool, authority-only replicated immutable choice

hooks.SetupPlayerInputComponent: After actual Enhanced Input bindings, call extension.SetupPlayerInputComponent
hooks.UnPossessed/EndPlay: UninitializeAbilitySystem; retain existing input context removal and delegate cleanup
hooks.BeginPlay: Subscribe to OnDataAvailable before Super::BeginPlay; callback and SetupPlayerInputComponent both retry the same idempotent actual input binding.

states: InitState.DataAvailable: selected PawnData, ready Experience, controller where authority/local pawn requires it
InitState.DataInitialized: ASC bound to this avatar, local player input prepared, all actor features at DataAvailable
InitState.GameplayReady: broadcasts after state manager has recorded the state
pawnExtension.lateReplication: Manager Ready checks all existing PawnExtensions in its world; PawnData replication, possession and input setup retry initialization. No per-frame polling.
pawnExtension.oldPawnSafety: Uninitialize only clears ASC avatar/cues/input if ASC.GetAvatarActor()==own pawn; an old pawn cannot detach a newer pawn.
pawnExtension.dataAvailableEventTiming: Broadcast from HandleChangeInitState before state manager records DataAvailable. Callback can bind input after checking Experience readiness/data/InputComponent, then set input-ready via extension.SetupPlayerInputComponent. Outer ContinueInitStateChain advances afterward; do not gate this callback on HasReachedInitState(DataAvailable).

instruction: This contract documents implementation and integration requirements. It does not assert that pending builds or runtime checks passed.

inputConfig.lookup: UInputAction* FindInputActionForTag(FGameplayTag) const; exact match; only returns loaded objects; invalid or absent tags return nullptr
inputConfig.ownership: PawnData.InputConfig and InputMappingContext; the client Experience closure loads config then its soft actions before Ready; dedicated server excludes input assets
inputConfig.binding: Main character binds after both InputComponent and replicated loaded PawnData are available; retry from OnRep/Ready as needed; remove context/listeners on teardown

abilityInput.lookup: TArray<FMMOGrantedAbilityInput> GetGrantedAbilitiesForInputTag(const FGameplayTag& InputTag); exact dynamic spec source-tag match; returns copied Handle, InputID and AbilityClassPath values, not pointers into the mutable ability list
abilityInput.activate: bool TryActivateAbilitiesByInputTag(const FGameplayTag& InputTag); authority and valid tag required; collect all matching handles under ABILITYLIST_SCOPE_LOCK, release the lock, then call TryActivateAbility for every collected handle; returns whether any activation succeeded
abilityInput.multiplicity: The reusable ASC supports multiple granted specs per input tag. The tutorial assets and smoke checks, not this generic method, require one Attack and one Spell spec with InputID=-1.
abilityInput.flow: Physical key -> real InputAction -> InputConfig semantic tag -> AMMOCharacter.ServerActivate(FGameplayTag) -> existing PlayerState ASC dynamic source-tag match -> TryActivateAbility; no numeric slot or ability class is sent in this RPC
abilityInput.authorization: AMMOCharacter.ServerActivate_Implementation accepts only Attack/Spell tags and checks authority, authenticated session, Pawn ready, alive health state, PS pawn, ASC owner/avatar and PawnExtension ASC identity before calling the generic ASC.
abilityInput.scope: Current Attack and Spell are ServerOnly instant abilities. This change does not add held/released queues, per-frame ProcessAbilityInput or local-prediction support.
